adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed validation (`handleAdd`), but it is only reset in the Cancel button handler. The dialog can also close via `Dialog`’s `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` (ESC/overlay/X), which does not reset `isInvalidEmail`. Additionally, `onSuccess` closes the dialog and resets `multiEmailValue`, but does not reset `isInvalidEmail`, so reopening the still-mounted component can immediately show the warning again (`{isInvalidEmail && (...)}` is unconditional).
